Claude: annotation FRAMES are change-bar gutter marks on flowing <li> items in a scrolling board column, not accents on cards — the borderless start-edge rule is the standard device for marking a line's state (diff gutters, document change bars) and carries the required colour for correct/wrong alongside the icon and sr-only label. The card-shaped callouts that the rule legitimately targets were fixed in callout.tsx instead.
